mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and a temperature of 57 degrees at Verona Community Park, all under the dark sky of a new moon.

Regarding city news, the Verona Police Department successfully took a 19-year-old Madison man into custody following a burglary and weapons incident on September 10. Additionally, the city is reminding residents that applications for the upcoming Citizen Police Academy are now open, offering a nine-week look into law enforcement operations starting September 23.

Today is a big day for the city as we host the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival. Additionally, you can enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can catch yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, or join in for trivia at the Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee starting Monday, September 15.
In our weekly police report, on Wednesday, September 10, officers responded to a burglary in progress on Hunter's Cove Way where a suspect was taken into custody following a report of a gunshot.
Today's flavor of the day is Really Reese's. The restaurant is currently closed but will be opening today at 10:00 AM for all your cravings.
